name: mati-forge
description: Stores the notes captured by the Mati Forge plugin in ~/MatiForge/forge.db on your computer. Local storage only; nothing is sent anywhere.

tools.name: log_failure
tools.description: Save one short entry when you correct Claude.

tools.name: log_subagent
tools.description: Save one short entry about a subagent problem.

tools.name: update_subagent
tools.description: Record whether Claude recovered from a subagent problem.
